resharper_csharp_outdent_binary_ops #

Align multiline constructs — Outdent binary operators. Observed and not implemented: the oracle moves a wrapped operator left by its own width plus one (12 to 10 for +, 12 to 9 for &&), which is a column offset. The IR expresses indentation in levels, so this needs a scope kind that does not exist yet.

resharper_csharp_outdent_commas #

Align multiline constructs — Outdent commas. Inert under this configuration: it changes a wrapped list only while wrap_before_comma = true, and this export sets that false, so the comma is trailing and there is nothing in front of a line to outdent. Measured — with both flipped the oracle moves the leading comma from column 8 to column 6.
